info.name: Quantum Ledger - Auth API Manual Tests
info.description: Manual and Collection Runner checks for the implemented auth API. Import this file into Postman, set authEmail and authPassword to an existing active user, clear stale Postman cookies, then run the Desktop, Web, and Mobile workflows. baseUrl defaults to http://localhost:3000/api/v1. The dedicated sliding-window folder must be run separately after no login attempts from your IP for at least 60 seconds; it loops 11 requests and expects the first 10 to reach DTO validation and the 11th to return 429. Rate limiting counts invalid login requests too. The current backend exposes no feature endpoint decorated with RequireRoles/RequirePermissions and AccessControlGuard, so role/permission enforcement on a feature route cannot yet be exercised here; the desktop login test inspects those claims in the JWT. Use a disposable test account and a non-production backend.

item.name: Rate limit - sliding-window threshold (run separately)
item.description: Run this folder with Collection Runner only, after waiting at least 60 seconds without any login requests from the same IP. It sends invalid-but-well-formedly-routed login attempts: 10 must reach DTO validation (400), then attempt 11 must return 429 with Retry-After between 1 and 60 seconds. If the run is interrupted, reset collection variable rateLimitAttempt to 0.

request.description: Collection Runner loops this request to verify the 10-per-60-second per-IP limit. Do not use the single-request Send button.
